subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: Should OpenClaw support Volcano Engine Lite UUID-style keys on the general `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201` route, steer them to `volcengine-plan`, or fail earlier with a clear unsupported key/model diagnostic?
rationale: The source shows a real split between general and coding endpoints, but only a maintainer or credentialed tester can confirm the vendor entitlement contract and choose whether to reroute, diagnose, or leave the split explicit.

options.title: Verify Lite route first
options.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/CodingPlan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Fail fast for unsupported pairs
options.body: If Lite keys are not valid for general DeepSeek models, setup or model selection should explain the unsupported key/model combination before runtime.

options.title: Keep waiting for reporter proof
options.body: Leave the issue blocked until a reporter provides endpoint, entitlement, and redacted live request details.

recommendation.title: Verify Lite route first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check with a Lite/CodingPlan key against both Volcengine endpoints, then implement the narrow provider-owned behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses provider auth aliases, bundled plugin ownership, and setup/runtime compatibility surfaces where this history is strongest.
